== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Engineer]] is a specialized role on the ship [[The Last Horizon]], filled by an individual with exceptional compatibility for [[Aethertech]] or a master-level status as an [[Aether Technician]]. While the Captain and crew make the final selection, the ship's own consciousness provides input on potential candidates. The position is vital for maintaining vessel functionality, as an Engineer can activate internal systems and drones, improve the ship's repair capabilities, and manage complex mechanical or magical issues. Without an Engineer, certain facilities may be limited and the ship's ability to recover from damage is hindered. The current Engineer is Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell, a master [[Aether Technician]] whose specific gift involves androids, allowing her to integrate systems and work with nearly any material to create humanoid robots.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|A master [[Aether Technician]] with a specialized gift for androids, the Engineer possesses the unique ability to integrate nearly any system into a humanoid robot. During their time with Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Doctor Mell, it is noted that the Engineer has the capability to restore the [[Horizon]] to prime condition. As the crew finds themselves trapped within a system, they realize that an Engineer is essential for their escape. Ultimately, the Engineer joins the crew as a new member, fulfilling a specific role that Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell had previously inquired about.}}
